meta.title: Semantic highlights
meta.description: Yellow = key point, red = risk, green = recommended action or key step, underline = qualifier. The model marks these in replies you read in the DSH Web page, and the marks show as highlighter strokes as the reply streams. To turn it off, open this plugin's page under Plugins and switch off Highlight replies: no new marks are written, and existing ones show as plain text. Adds one paragraph to every system prompt. A mark is a Markdown link to hl:key, hl:risk, hl:head, or hl:note, so it appears as that link in copied Markdown source, and keyboard and screen-reader users meet it as a link that does nothing.
